v3lum data import-por <file> --exchange --date --source-url [--signature-verified] (WP18 data commands) calling v3lum.modules.crypto.crypto_address_labels.import_por_file (P358 cond 2); until then the analyst calls the function or drops the CSV plus a <name>.provenance.json sidecar (schema v3lum.crypto_por_import/1) into setting crypto_address_labels_por_dir.

Engine stop-node rule (P213): do not auto-expand pivots emitted from a node that carries attribute stop_node_hint (exchange, custodial_service, mixer, bridge, pool, service, defi, sanctioned), whichever module emitted them; crypto_address_labels sets the attribute and pivots institutions with expand=False.

Core home for the in-memory safe ZIP reader (P365 'single safe archive helper'): crypto_address_labels imports zip_scan/zip_read/Budget/ArchiveLimit from v3lum/modules/file_analysis/file_type_sniff.py (batch p1-G12-1) because v3lum.core.datasets.safe_extract only extracts to disk and P358 cond 1 requires an in-memory read without extraction.

v3lum.core.datasets: a post-install hook (or re-validation when a dataset is 'unchanged' but its derived index is missing), so derived SQLite indexes are always rebuilt by `v3lum data update`; crypto_address_labels (like tranco_rank) rebuilds a missing index at the first lookup (timeout 180 s).

WP29 packaging/CI: install the optional extra 'yaml' (PyYAML) in the deployment and CI images; the repository venv has none, so the GraphSense index can only be built where it is installed (the offline tests replay recorded yaml.safe_load results and check them against PyYAML when present).
